AgentDraftRequest.description: A description of a new agent.

blocked.description: Tools that keep it from starting, with the reason.

editable.description: Whether the apps can change it.

schedule.description: Cron expression, if it runs on a schedule.

agent_id.description: The agent that proposes the call.

quotes_external.description: Whether the run had read external content, which may have shaped the proposal.

run_id.description: Run that holds the costs of this answer.

sources.description: The entries it is based on.

setup_required.description: Whether the owner still has to set a password.

BatchDecision.description: One decision on many proposals, for example a batch of similar ones.

ConnectStarted.description: Answer when an OAuth flow started.

authorize_url.description: URL to open in a browser.

connected.description: Whether the needed credential is stored.

read_tools.description: Tools that run directly because they only read.

DailyCost.description: Model costs of one day and provider.

Device.description: A device that can sign in.

DeviceKind.description: What kind of client holds a token.

links.description: Links to other entries, such as `project:release-2-14`.

original.description: File name of the original, for uploaded files.

EntrySummary.description: An entry without its text, for lists.

original.description: File name of the original, for uploaded files.

sources.description: Sources. An entry without a source is not stored.

NewPermission.description: A permission request from a session.

Node.description: A machine with a desktop agent.

id.description: Node ID, the same as its device ID.

paused.description: Pauses remote actions and denies open requests.

NodeReport.description: What a desktop agent sends regularly.

PermissionDecision.description: A decision on a permission request.

reason.description: Why the run did not succeed.

score.description: Fusion score. Only the order means anything.

SessionReport.description: A session as a desktop agent reports it.

Source.description: Where an entry comes from. Every entry needs at least one source.

kind.description: Kind of source, for example `app`, `meeting` or `agent`.

TokenIssued.description: A device token. It is shown only once.

TokenRequest.description: A request for a token without a password.
